data.description: Elegant Residential Living with Premium Amenities
data.display_address: Waref Residences, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Waref Residences offers a modern living experience in the tranquil neighborhood of Jumeirah Village Circle. The building’s contemporary design, with glass balconies and natural accents, provides a stylish and welcoming exterior. Its location combines privacy with convenient access to Dubai’s key destinations.

The interiors are designed to balance comfort with elegance. Open layouts, neutral tones, and premium finishes create harmonious spaces suitable for relaxation and daily living. Balconies offer an extension of the living space, ideal for enjoying fresh air or hosting guests.

Residents can take advantage of a variety of lifestyle amenities, including a swimming pool, children’s pool, gym, barbecue area, open-air cinema, and playground. Fifth-floor balconies feature jacuzzis and lounge areas, offering luxurious outdoor relaxation with scenic views.
